title: ITR-5 Online Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Live on e-filing Portal!
content:
# ITR-5 Online Utility for AY 2026-27 Now Live on e-filing Portal!

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27 ke liye ITR-5 ki online utility e-filing portal par available kar di hai.

*   This crucial step allows eligible taxpayers to start filing their Income Tax Returns for the Financial Year 2025-26.
*   The online utility for ITR-5 became available on the e-filing portal on August 5, 2026.
*   ITR-5 is applicable to various non-individual entities, including Partnership Firms, Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), Associations of Persons (AOPs), Bodies of Individuals (BOIs), Cooperative Societies, Local Authorities, and specific Trusts.
*   Taxpayers can now proceed to fill and submit their ITR-5 online, ensuring timely compliance.

## Read the Official Document
* [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.incometax.gov.in/)

*Published on: 6 August 2026*
